title: [GMCP 203.043.06] Operations and evidence: Cross-platform packaging, service integration, and distribution
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-043-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Identical supported GMCP capability is packaged for Linux, macOS and Windows across x86_64 and arm64 with signed, reproducible artifacts, service-manager integration, upgrade/rollback, uninstall, path/permission handling and diagnostics. A declared parity matrix has automated clean-machine, non-admin, Unicode-path, sleep/resume and upgrade tests; unavoidable platform differences are explicit and policy-safe. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
